title: A chart's filter choice is still set on your next visit
pre_body:
Preconditions

  1. User: you are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. Location: you are in one location (workplace) with the data below.
  3. Browser: you use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
  4. People: at least two technicians and at least two service advisors have invoiced work with clocked time this month in this location.
  5. Browser: you use the same browser throughout (the choice is kept in this browser only).
